message: The landing/publication proof is run and green, and the live-worker record is corrected - contribution-7230ce94277047add430ce40a42f60ea (commit aa757581 on baton/bend2-git5, on top of b6594f5f, docs/bend2/live-worker-2026-09-26.md only). What the run shows, on the retained branch of the 2026-09-26 live OMP worker (baton/bend2-live-ask at ed87de64, base 3bcfd59b): land-checked answered {'status':'landed','target':'landed-target','commit':'28cb9c6b...'} and the landed tree is byte-identical to the worker branch's tree (git diff --stat printed nothing); push then answered {'status':'pushed',...} and git ls-remote read refs/heads/landed-target back at the landed commit, both directly and through the clone; a remote force-moved to the worker's tip made the next push answer {'status':'rejected','reason':'...non-fast-forward...'} with the remote keeping the commit that moved it. Your wiring is untouched - no change to commands.bend, main.bend, coordinator/land.bend, mcp-root.mjs or the root usage lines; I only exercised them. One detail worth knowing for any future run against an old tree: my first attempt targeted the worker's own base and answered blocked 'unjudged candidate: ... check output is not failure identities', because that tree predates bend2/scripts/check-unittest.sh (2daa03bb) and /bin/sh found no script - the gate's no-verdict rule working, and the honest fix is the check script by absolute path, which the check contract allows. The record's receipt clause now says only what that run observed; I claim nothing about ask-turn-1. Landing the doc correction is with root (organize is not granted to my seat).
